title: Attraction closed / override / schedule / hours
preconditions: Console open. Pick a named attraction with hours (e.g. Conservation Carousel or Zoomobile-related attraction).
dateUnderTest: **D** = future date used for closed + itinerary checks.
cleanup: Restore open state and sensible hours; remove test closures/overrides.

steps.name: Set attraction hours
steps.do: Open **Set attraction hours**. Set weekday and weekend/holiday start/end within zoo hours.

steps.name: Itinerary hours snap
steps.do: On itinerary for a day those hours apply, schedule the attraction outside its open window.
steps.expect: UI snaps to nearest valid time or warns — note which.

steps.name: Set attraction closed
steps.do: Open **Set attraction as closed** for range covering D + message.

steps.name: Map closed
steps.do: Map on D with **Include closed attractions** unchecked then checked.
steps.expect: Hidden/closed without include; visible + message with include.

steps.name: Itinerary closed confirm
steps.do: Try adding the attraction on D.
steps.expect: **Attraction May Be Closed** / closed confirm appears.

steps.name: Override or reopen
steps.do: Use **Create attraction closure override** or set open / end closure so D is effectively open.

steps.name: Opening schedule
steps.do: Open **Set attraction opening schedule**; set a weekly pattern.
steps.expect: Saves, or **Schedule conflict** dialog if overlapping (**Trim Old Schedules** / **Delete Old Schedules**).

steps.name: Resolve overlap if shown
steps.do: If overlap dialog appears, choose Trim or Delete and confirm.

steps.name: Map open state
steps.expect: Attraction appears open/normal without needing include-closed.

steps.name: Hours still valid
steps.do: Spot-check itinerary scheduling still respects hours.

steps.name: Cleanup
steps.do: Remove test closure/override; leave attraction open.
